'''Xinle''' is male Midnight Ranger NPC located in {{Location|Jinzhou (Area)}}, found nearby [[Yhan]] and [[Qingxi]]. He is the older brother of [[Jinyue]].

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|Xinle}}

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Xinle}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Xinle:''' Is there anything I can help with?
:{{DIcon}} It's nothing, I'm just wandering around.
:'''Xinle:''' I see... If you're requesting a visit, please register here... and go through the security search. Hmm... You're all set. Please remember, "Keep quite while you're in the military facility."
----
;(Exhaust all of Jinyue dialogues)
:'''Xinle:''' Excuse me, ar you the... Rover? The one who helped Jinyue find that "treasure" a while ago?
:'''Xinle:''' Jinyue told me everything. I'm so sorry for the troubles my younger brother has caused you.
:{{DIcon}} No trouble at all, just a piece of cake.
::'''Xinle:''' For you've helped out Jinyue, as his older brother, I should show my gratitude. Feel free to come to me if you have any difficulties in the future.
:{{DIcon}} It's quite a hassle...
::'''Xinle:''' Oh, allow me to apologize on he behalf. For you've helped out Jinyue, as his older brother, I should show my gratitude. Feel free to come to me if you have any difficulties in the future.
:'''Xinle:''' But let me tell you in advance, if it's about the military base, I'm afraid I can't help...
:'''Xinle:''' As long as I'm a Midnight Ranger, I'll guard the base with my life for it's my duty, after all. I hope you can understand. 
{{Dialogue End}}
